_doc: Findings a human has accepted for this release, each naming its card.
The smoke report is EVIDENCE and is never edited to make a gate pass. This
file is the separate, reviewable record of which findings were triaged and
consciously shipped with - so the acceptance is auditable, attributable and
sits next to the evidence rather than inside it.
The release skill's own rule: a pre-existing finding 'does not block - it
gets a card and a line in the audit file, so the delta stays honest'.
Rules the gate enforces, so this cannot become a dumping ground:
- every entry names a real card id and a reason;
- every entry names the version it is accepted FOR, and is ignored for any
other version, so an acceptance cannot silently carry forward;
- a finding in the report that is NOT listed here still blocks.
Accepting a finding is a decision someone made. Removing an entry is how you
`resolved` is NOT `accepted`. An accepted finding ships as-is. A resolved one
was FIXED after the walk recorded it, so the report is simply stale for that
entry - and the honest answer to a stale report is a re-walk. Where a re-walk
was not run, the entry must say exactly how the fix was verified instead, so a
reader can weigh that evidence rather than assume a walk covered it.

resolved.verified_by: Browser, Local site at Pro ff4c840: Sell Services > Settings loads with zero JS errors; #wpss-save-plan, #wpss-save-subscription-settings, #wpss-save-rule and #wpss-wl-save each have a click handler; clicking White Label Save sent wpss_pro_save_white_label and returned success 'Settings saved.'. tests/test-js-namespace-calls-defined.php fails on the old admin.js (WPSSPro.initStorageSettings() undefined) and passes on the fix.

The tip modal Cancel now carries wpss-btn--secondary like every other modal Cancel. tests/test-design-token-integrity.php section 8 (every .wpss-btn carries a variant) fails on the old template naming this button and passes on the fix.

A real inconsistency, not intended: the service card hid New for a complete profile while the vendor directory and profile always showed it, each with its own markup. All three now render templates/partials/vendor-level-badge.php and every level shows everywhere (journey 22 updated to say so). Verified on Docker at 1280 and 390, Pro on and off (surface vendor-badge); tests/test-vendor-level-badge-one-renderer.php fails on the old card.

The teaser text read --wpss-wp-admin-* tokens that do not flip in dark mode. Now design-system greys: measured 9.86:1 light and 12.71:1 dark on /dashboard/create/ on Docker at 1280 and 390 (surface dashboard-sections). Token test section 9 fails on the old pro-teaser.css and unified-dashboard.css.

resolved.fixed_in: wp-sell-services d7d55d38 (journey text, not product code)
resolved.verified_by: Code read plus the combo walk observation at 56381157: Journey 03 listed the slug become-vendor; the installer creates become-a-vendor (src/functions/urls.php) and the router accepts both. The combo walk observed become-a-vendor with the right title and shortcode.

Tuning settings clamp the raw (int) now, so -4 stores the field minimum. tests/test-settings-no-negative-numbers.php (reminder -4 => 1, 999 => 30, decimal places -2 => 0, realtime port -6001 => 443) fails on the old Settings.php (4 FAIL) and passes on the fix. Not re-walked in the browser.

Every Settings form and the four order-screen forms pass their own submit id (wpss-save-*, wpss-order-*); wpss_submit_button() takes an optional id. tests/test-settings-unique-ids.php renders the whole Settings page: 18 submit buttons, no repeated id, zero id="submit"; it fails on the old code (6 FAIL). Not re-walked in the browser.

Owner decision A: the admin_init auto-vendor hook is gone; an administrator gets an active profile the first time they author a service, or at once on Start Selling. Existing rows are left untouched. tests/test-admin-is-not-auto-vendor.php fails on the old Plugin.php (4 FAIL) and passes on the fix. The full suite was not re-run on a pristine database (tests that assume user 1 is a vendor would need wpss_test_activate_vendor()).

EmailService skips the vendor copy of Now In Progress when the Requirements Submitted mail went out for that order in the same request; the buyer still gets In Progress and skip/timeout/resume paths still mail the vendor. tests/test-requirements-submit-one-vendor-email.php fails on the old EmailService (2 FAIL) and passes on the fix.

NotificationService::notify_order_status() handles pending_requirements as the new-order event (any rail) and silences the generic row for late; the empty(old_status) branch in Plugin.php is gone. tests/test-paid-order-one-email.php: one mail per party, vendor row order_created, no order_status row on late; fails on the old code (6 FAIL).

Root cause was wider than the card: API::normalise_response_dates() was hooked only in the never-called API::init(), so no route was normalised over HTTP. Now wired in Plugin::define_api_hooks(); api:shapes runs rest_post_dispatch so it measures served output. GET /disputes/857 (status note) served with created_at 2026-11-02T12:10:52+00:00; wp wpss api:shapes exits 0 (86 routes). tests/test-time-sweep.php asserts the hook. Authenticated HTTP probe not run (no app password).

resolved.id: 13-6c vendor application reject carries no reason
resolved.verified_by: Reject and Suspend ask for an optional reason (wpssConfirm prompt); it travels set_status() -> wpss_vendor_status_updated (4th arg) -> email, in-app row and audit note. tests/test-vendor-rejection-carries-reason.php fails on the old VendorService (7 FAIL) and passes on the fix.

resolved.id: 05-P2-6b refused publish is silent on the vendor dashboard and REST
resolved.verified_by: PUT /services/{id} status=publish settles the status after meta/terms/gallery and answers 400 wpss_not_publishable with data.errors when the service cannot go live; the dashboard shows responseJSON.message. tests/test-rest-publish-refusal-is-explained.php fails on the old controller (4 FAIL) and passes on the fix.

resolved.verified_by: Not a Free defect: Free reads no wallet provider other than Internal, and the fallback notice lives in Pro (licensed). Journey 19 step 1 now says (Pro, licensed), seeds wpss_wallet_provider, and gives the Free-only expectation.
